# GT-001 baseline

- Commit: `20257e08c234dde46f888df66a9e71f27b5aa83a`
- Host: Darwin arm64, Apple M4 Max
- Go benchmark parallelism: 16
- Repetitions: 5
- Command:

```bash
go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkBattle' -benchmem -count=5 ./pkg/server ./pkg/handler ./pkg/text
```

## Median results

| Benchmark | Workload | ns/op | B/op | allocs/op |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `BenchmarkBattleValidateEnabledTools` | Validate all 31 canonical names | 636.0 | 1,832 | 3 |
| `BenchmarkBattleMarshalMessagesCompact` | Render 100 messages plus legends | 45,420 | 91,577 | 1,060 |
| `BenchmarkBattleProcessText` | Normalize 20 repeated link/mention clauses | 47,714 | 44,730 | 113 |

## Raw ns/op

- `BenchmarkBattleValidateEnabledTools`: 623.3, 640.7, 631.8, 636.0, 648.9
- `BenchmarkBattleMarshalMessagesCompact`: 45,420, 45,806, 45,912, 44,546, 45,400
- `BenchmarkBattleProcessText`: 47,767, 47,714, 47,814, 47,699, 46,894

Numbers record ground truth only. No optimization claim.
